about:
# Achievement Counter

The <cy>Achievement Counter</c> Mod adds an <cp>overlay</c> displaying the <cf>current amount of achivements</c> you made in the game!

This mod was made for the <cg>TCD Achievement race!</c>

-----------------

To customize things about the overlay, <cy>check out the mod setting!</c> :D
